nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$ and $\chi$ a ray class character of $m$. If a nonzero fractional ideal $\mathfrak a$ of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $m$ lies in the ray group of $m$, then the value of $\chi$ at the ray class of $\mathfrak a$, regarded as a complex number, is $1$.
nodes.title: Ray class characters take the complex value $1$ on the ray group

nodes.summary: For a ray class character $\chi$ of a modulus $m$ and a ray class $x$ of $m$, the complex value of $\chi$ at $x$ is $\chi(x)$, a point of the unit circle, regarded as a complex number.
nodes.title: Complex value of a ray class character

nodes.summary: Let $\chi$ be a ray class character of a modulus $m$ of a number field $K$. Its extension by zero assigns to a nonzero fractional ideal $\mathfrak a$ of $K$ the complex number $\chi([\mathfrak a])$ if $\mathfrak a$ is coprime to the finite part of $m$, where $[\mathfrak a]$ is the ray class of $\mathfrak a$, and the value $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Extension by zero of a ray class character

nodes.summary: Let $m_1$ and $m_2$ be moduli of a number field $K$ with $m_1 \mid m_2$, that is, the finite part of $m_2$ is contained in the finite part of $m_1$ and every real place of $m_1$ is a real place of $m_2$. Then for every finite prime $v$ of $K$ (a height-one prime of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$), the exponent of $v$ in the finite part of $m_1$ is at most the exponent of $v$ in the finite part of $m_2$.

nodes.summary: Let $\chi$ be a ray class character of a modulus $m$ of a number field $K$. If a nonzero fractional ideal $\mathfrak a$ of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $m$ lies in the ray group of $m$, then the pullback of $\chi$ to the fractional ideals coprime to the finite part of $m$ takes the value $1$ at $\mathfrak a$.
nodes.title: Pulled-back ray class characters are trivial on the ray group

nodes.summary: For a ray class character $\chi$ of a modulus $m$ of a number field $K$, its pullback is the group homomorphism from the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $m$ to the unit circle sending $\mathfrak a$ to $\chi([\mathfrak a])$, where $[\mathfrak a]$ is the ray class of $\mathfrak a$.
nodes.title: Pullback of a ray class character to ideals

nodes.summary: A ray class character of a modulus $m$ of a number field $K$ is a group homomorphism from the ray class group of $m$ to the unit circle $\{z \in \mathbb C : |z| = 1\}$.
nodes.title: Ray class character

nodes.summary: The trivial ray class character of a modulus $m$ of a number field $K$ is the ray class character sending every ray class of $m$ to $1$.
nodes.title: Trivial character

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
